```{r setup, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(philentropy)
library(cluster)
library(fpc)
library(DirichletMultinomial)
library(factoextra)
library(pheatmap)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(reshape2)
library(vegan)
library(dendextend)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(here)

# Parameters
run_name   <- params$run_name
output_dir <- params$output_dir
prefix     <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data}
# Species relative abundance (rows: species, columns: samples)
df <- read_excel(here("data", "species_abundance.xlsx"), sheet = "species_relabund")

# Aggregate relative abundance to genus level
df$genus <- gsub("s__([^_]+)_.*", "g__\\1", df$clade_name)
df$genus <- ifelse(grepl("^g__", df$clade_name), df$clade_name, df$genus)

df_genus <- df %>%
  select(-clade_name) %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE))

write.xlsx(df_genus,
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "abundance_by_genus.xlsx")),
           rowNames = FALSE)

# Build sample x genus matrix
mat <- t(as.matrix(df_genus[, -1]))
colnames(mat) <- df_genus$genus
rownames(mat) <- colnames(df_genus)[-1]
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

cat("Samples:", nrow(mat), "\n")
cat("Genera:", ncol(mat), "\n")
```

## 2. PAM Clustering (Jensen-Shannon Distance)

```{r pam-clustering}
set.seed(2024)

# Compute Jensen-Shannon distance
jsd_matrix <- distance(mat, method = "jensen-shannon", mute.message = TRUE)
jsd_dist   <- as.dist(jsd_matrix)

# Evaluate k = 2:5 using silhouette width and Calinski-Harabasz index
sil_width  <- c()
ch_index   <- c()
pam_results <- list()

for (k in 2:5) {
  set.seed(2024)
  pam_fit      <- pam(jsd_dist, k = k)
  sil_width[k] <- pam_fit$silinfo$avg.width
  ch_index[k]  <- calinhara(mat, pam_fit$clustering)
  pam_results[[k]] <- pam_fit
}

# Select optimal k
optimal_k     <- which.max(sil_width)
optimal_k_ch  <- which.max(ch_index)
pam_final     <- pam_results[[optimal_k]]
pam_cluster   <- pam_final$clustering

cat("Optimal k (silhouette):", optimal_k, "\n")
cat("Optimal k (CH index):", optimal_k_ch, "\n")

# Clustering evaluation summary
eval_df <- data.frame(
  k              = 2:5,
  Silhouette     = sil_width[2:5],
  CH_index       = ch_index[2:5]
)
print(eval_df)

final_eval_df <- data.frame(
  Optimal_k                = optimal_k,
  Average_Silhouette_Score = pam_final$silinfo$avg.width,
  Interpretation           = ifelse(pam_final$silinfo$avg.width > 0.70, "Strong structure",
                             ifelse(pam_final$silinfo$avg.width > 0.50, "Reasonable structure",
                             ifelse(pam_final$silinfo$avg.width > 0.25, "Weak structure",
                                    "No substantial structure")))
)

write.xlsx(list(Evaluation_by_k  = eval_df,
               Final_Summary     = final_eval_df),
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "PAM_evaluation_summary.xlsx")),
           rowNames = FALSE)

# Assign enterotype labels based on dominant genus
pam_genus_summary <- lapply(1:optimal_k, function(i) {
  grp     <- mat[pam_cluster == i, , drop = FALSE]
  mean_ab <- colMeans(grp)
  sort(mean_ab, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
})

genus_names <- sapply(1:optimal_k, function(i) {
  top_genus  <- names(pam_genus_summary[[i]])[1]
  paste0(gsub("g__", "", top_genus), "-type")
})

pam_et_tbl <- data.frame(
  SampleID      = rownames(mat),
  Enterotype_PAM = genus_names[pam_cluster]
)

write.xlsx(pam_et_tbl,
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "enterotype_PAM.xlsx")),
           rowNames = FALSE)

cat("Enterotype distribution (PAM):\n")
print(table(pam_et_tbl$Enterotype_PAM))
```

## 3. Stacked Barplot — Mean Genus Abundance per Enterotype (PAM)

```{r stacked-barplot-pam}
mat_long <- melt(
  as.data.frame(mat) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
  id.vars = "SampleID", variable.name = "Genus", value.name = "Abundance"
) %>% left_join(pam_et_tbl, by = "SampleID")

plot_data_pam <- mat_long %>%
  group_by(Enterotype_PAM, Genus) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Enterotype_PAM) %>%
  mutate(RelAbund = MeanAbundance / sum(MeanAbundance))

top10_pam <- plot_data_pam %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(Sum = sum(RelAbund), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = Sum, n = 10) %>%
  pull(Genus)

p_bar_pam <- ggplot(filter(plot_data_pam, Genus %in% top10_pam),
                    aes(x = Enterotype_PAM, y = RelAbund, fill = Genus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "Mean Genus Abundance by Enterotype (PAM)",
       x = "Enterotype", y = "Mean Relative Abundance") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")

print(p_bar_pam)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "barplot_genus_by_enterotype_PAM.png")),
       p_bar_pam, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

write.xlsx(filter(plot_data_pam, Genus %in% top10_pam),
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "barplot_genus_PAM_top10.xlsx")),
           rowNames = FALSE)
```

## 4. PCoA — Bray-Curtis, Coloured by Enterotype

```{r pcoa-bray-pam}
# Compute Bray-Curtis distance
bray_dist   <- vegdist(mat, method = "bray")
bray_matrix <- as.matrix(bray_dist)
write.xlsx(bray_matrix,
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "braycurtis_distance_matrix.xlsx")),
           rowNames = TRUE)

# PCoA
pcoa_res    <- cmdscale(bray_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
pcoa_points <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
colnames(pcoa_points) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_points$SampleID  <- rownames(pcoa_points)

eig_vals  <- pcoa_res$eig
var_exp   <- eig_vals[1:2] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]) * 100
xlab_pcoa <- sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1])
ylab_pcoa <- sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])

# PAM
plot_df_pam <- merge(pcoa_points, pam_et_tbl, by = "SampleID")

p_pcoa_pam <- ggplot(plot_df_pam,
                     aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Enterotype_PAM)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis) — PAM Enterotypes",
       x = xlab_pcoa, y = ylab_pcoa, color = "Enterotype") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

print(p_pcoa_pam)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "PCoA_BrayCurtis_PAM.png")),
       p_pcoa_pam, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "PCoA_BrayCurtis_PAM_labels.png")),
       p_pcoa_pam + geom_text(aes(label = SampleID), vjust = -0.5, size = 2),
       width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r pcoa-jsd-pam}
# PCoA on JSD distance — PAM
pcoa_jsd    <- cmdscale(jsd_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
pcoa_jsd_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_jsd$points)
colnames(pcoa_jsd_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_jsd_df$SampleID  <- rownames(mat)

eig_jsd   <- pcoa_jsd$eig
var_jsd   <- eig_jsd[1:2] / sum(eig_jsd[eig_jsd > 0]) * 100

plot_jsd_pam <- merge(pcoa_jsd_df, pam_et_tbl, by = "SampleID")

p_pcoa_jsd <- ggplot(plot_jsd_pam,
                     aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Enterotype_PAM)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(title = "PCoA (Jensen-Shannon) — PAM Enterotypes",
       x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_jsd[1]),
       y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_jsd[2]),
       color = "Enterotype") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

print(p_pcoa_jsd)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "PCoA_JSD_PAM.png")),
       p_pcoa_jsd, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 5. PERMANOVA and Betadisper

```{r permanova}
# Homogeneity of dispersion — PAM
disp_pam <- betadisper(bray_dist, group = pam_et_tbl$Enterotype_PAM)
permutest(disp_pam, pairwise = TRUE)

# PERMANOVA — PAM
adonis_pam <- adonis2(bray_dist ~ Enterotype_PAM,
                      data = pam_et_tbl, permutations = 999)
print(adonis_pam)

# Pairwise PERMANOVA — PAM (if > 2 enterotypes)
if (length(unique(pam_et_tbl$Enterotype_PAM)) > 2) {
  pw_pam <- pairwise.adonis(mat, factors = pam_et_tbl$Enterotype_PAM,
                             sim.method = "bray", p.adjust.m = "fdr")
  print(pw_pam)
  write.xlsx(pw_pam,
             file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "pairwise_PERMANOVA_PAM.xlsx")))
}

```
